message: Live QA hotfix: existing Race Off saves can now recover FH5 variant identity from the frozen make/year/classType snapshot when an old source car ID is stale, fixing the Morris Minor 1000 / Forza Edition ambiguity in Slot 003. Car History also restores the guaranteed fixed BACK control from v8.0.66. v8.0.88 Championship Career content, v8.0.87 LOCATION clues, Evil bridge, Results/Corrections and rh-guide are otherwise unchanged.
